6349.title: Canonical tab collisions block synchronization
6349.rootCauseOneLine: Legacy built-in tab normalization retains duplicate canonical identifiers, so client-side validation blocks persistence and local migration before the SDK update.
6349.proposedFix: Deduplicate identifiers after canonicalization in the shared app persistence helper, retaining the first occurrence and tab order.
6349.caveats: Unit-level production-module reproduction repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout; no live browser or server/database experiment.
